title: Agnostos: resume-driven academic outreach for research internships
description:
Agnostos is an open-source command-line tool that helps students find research internships. It parses a resume, builds a professor list from a research topic via the OpenAlex works index (first/last authors, relevance floor, field anchoring, seniority gate) or reads an existing spreadsheet, ranks it locally with a TF-IDF cosine plus a saturating domain-term bonus, enriches each professor with recent first/last-author papers, and makes one language-model call per professor for an acceptance estimate and a short honest email. Drafts pass through a deterministic deslop stage and a rule-based AI-tell score with a conditional rewrite. Addresses are verified by DNS and name matching and repaired from the professor's own pages. Mail is sent with throttling inside recipient-local working hours, and replies are tracked over IMAP with drafted follow-ups.

Documentation: avinashistoocool.github.io/Agnostos-v2
